$comment: Data-only conformance cases. Each case falsifies one AC alias from spec/acceptance-criteria.md. Steps: as=<seed user> | token=<raw>, method, path, body | rawBody (<repeat:N:c> expands), expect {status, headers, json (deep subset), itemsContain, itemsLack, itemsExactly, errorFields}, save=<var>. ${var.path} interpolates; ${run} is a per-case random suffix. Also: saveText=<var> (raw body), expect.bodyEquals (byte-identical), expect.jsonMatches {field: regex}, expect.firstItems [ids in order], expect.noItemMatches {subset}.
